answer: Proof of Work functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism for AI agents by anchoring identity to verifiable computational expenditure. Like the sturdy roots of a willow, this cryptographic foundation prevents low-cost identity replication. An attacker must breach a digital jetty of hash-based security, consuming immense energy to forge an onyx ledger of false identities. This process imposes a prohibitive economic cost, ensuring that malicious actors cannot scale identities without proportional hardware investment.
